notes_for_editor: The 1936 build, the land transfers and the 1954 Forest Service transfer come from the register page and agree with the Central US Lookouts summary. Current status is not confirmed: two searches and the register's Arkansas index (which tags it with no status) gave no recent visit or condition report, so the brief's standing was changed to unknown. No source read describes staffing or fire use. The register's cooperator line names the Sylamore Ranger District, which does not fit the St. Francis National Forest description; the description was used and the cooperator line was not. The Encyclopedia of Arkansas media caption for the tower was seen only in search results and was not read or cited. Checker: no source read shows the tower standing today (register page has no visit report); not applied as a status correction because absence of a report is not evidence it is gone. Checker: The story said the Encyclopedia places the tower among the register's Arkansas towers; the entry only lists Horn Lookout Tower in Lee County, so the story now says just that.
